name: Anthropic
purpose: AI-powered schedule generation via Claude API; AI host replies to the Controller's diners (web chat and phone) via Claude API
data_processed: Employee names, roles, skill levels, availability windows, and interpersonal affinity scores; for the AI host: diner conversation text and the reservation details the AI host looks up (diner names, phone numbers, party sizes, reservation dates and times)
safeguards: Data transmitted via encrypted API calls; not retained beyond request lifecycle; not used for model training

name: 7shifts
data_processed: Employee names, roles, shift schedules, and related workforce data
safeguards: Data transferred only at customer's explicit request; encrypted in transit via TLS

name: Resend
data_processed: Email addresses, recipient names, email content
safeguards: Data processed solely for email delivery; encrypted in transit; subject to Resend's data processing terms

name: PostgreSQL Hosting Provider
data_processed: All application data including user accounts, employee profiles, availability, schedules, and consent records
safeguards: Encryption at rest and in transit; access restricted to application service; regular backups with encryption

name: Amazon Web Services
purpose: AI host phone calls (Amazon Connect telephony, Amazon Lex speech recognition, Amazon Polly speech synthesis, AWS Lambda) and anonymous AI host analytics (Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena)
data_processed: Diner call audio, caller ID numbers, recognized speech and the AI host's spoken replies; analytics data holds no diner names, phone numbers or email addresses
safeguards: Calls are not recorded; Contact Lens and Lex conversation logs are not turned on; Connect call flow logs (which include caller ID numbers) are deleted after 30 days; Lambda logs hold no caller numbers or speech and are deleted after 14 days; Lambda calls to WizScheduler use HTTPS

name: Stripe
purpose: Subscription billing and card payments, including the AI host subscription
data_processed: Customer billing contact details, payment card details, invoices, and AI host usage amounts per billing period; no diner data
safeguards: Card details are collected by Stripe Checkout and not stored by WizScheduler; encrypted in transit
